feeds.term: (lecanemab OR donanemab OR "anti-amyloid" OR "tau-targeting" OR trontinemab) AND ("clinical trial"[Publication Type] OR phase OR efficacy)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.title: 诊断 · 生物标志物
feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.title: 预防 · 生活方式
feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Cognitive-enhancing drugs in Phase II clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease: emerging therapeutic candidates.
drug.zh: II期促智药试验多数认知改善有限，亟需精准生物标志物与更优试验设计。

drug.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Chalcones in Alzheimer's Disease: Mechanistic Insights and SAR Perspectives.
drug.zh: 查尔酮母核经卤代或三氟甲基修饰可增强AD多靶点抑制活性，为MTDLs设计提供SAR依据。

drug.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样单抗对早期AD疗效与安全性异质性显著，临床获益有限且不良反应风险需警惕。

drug.title: Streamlining eligibility assessment for Alzheimer's disease-modifying therapies: Prediction of MMSE scores using the digital clock and recall.
drug.zh: 数字时钟与回忆测试可高效预测MMSE评分，有望简化阿尔茨海默病DMT治疗资格评估。

drug.title: Six-month real-world amyloid PET outcomes after lecanemab: Greater amyloid reduction at the MCI stage than in dementia.
drug.zh: 真实世界数据表明，仑卡奈单抗在MCI期清除淀粉样蛋白的效果优于痴呆期。

drug.title: The Clearance-Centered Bottleneck in Alzheimer's Disease: From Coupled Glymphatic-Lymphatic Circuits to Therapeutic Opportunities.
drug.zh: 提出以清除为中心的新框架，揭示AD三大限速节点及治疗靶点。

drug.title: Nanomedicine targeting neuroinflammatory pathways in Alzheimer's disease: a new frontier in inflammopharmacology.
drug.zh: 纳米药物可精准调控神经炎症通路，为阿尔茨海默病治疗开辟新前沿。

drug.title: Hospital Budget Impact and Provider-Side Economic Evaluation of Lecanemab and Donanemab Under Japan's National Fee Schedule: A Head-to-Head Linear Model.
drug.zh: 日本医保下仑卡奈单抗与多奈单抗门诊输注均亏损，需高病例量方能收支平衡。

mech.title: Peripheral Administration of isoD7-Aβ Exacerbates Motor Deficits and Tau Pathology in P301S Mice.
mech.zh: 外周注射isoD7-Aβ加剧P301S小鼠运动缺陷及tau病理，提示外周淀粉样负荷可经Akt/GSK-3β通路恶化中枢病变。

mech.title: AI-Enabled Modeling for Alzheimer's Disease Risk Prediction and Validation.
mech.zh: 基于多模态临床数据构建的AI模型可有效预测阿尔茨海默病风险并完成验证。

mech.title: Investigating the Therapeutic Mechanism of Ginkgo Biloba Extract in Alzheimer's Disease via Integrated Network Pharmacology and Molecular Docking.
mech.zh: 银杏内酯通过多靶点协同调控凋亡与炎症通路发挥抗阿尔茨海默病作用。

mech.title: LncRNA DLX6-AS1 Regulates the Pathological Process Related to Alzheimer's Disease via miR-204-5p.
mech.zh: DLX6-AS1通过靶向miR-204-5p调控AD病理，或为早期诊断新标志物。

mech.title: Retinal proteome changes mirror brain pathology and reveal synaptic and cytoskeletal dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 视网膜蛋白质组变化可镜像脑内病理，揭示突触及细胞骨架功能障碍。

mech.title: Topography of Juxtaventricular white matter hyperintensities and cognitive associations in Alzheimer's disease: a dual-cohort study.
mech.zh: 近脑室白质高信号负荷与阿尔茨海默病认知损害及淀粉样病理显著相关。

mech.title: SOX9 knockdown alleviates Aβ1‑42‑induced neuroinflammation by regulating microglial polarization via inactivation of the ASK1/JNK signaling pathway.
mech.zh: 敲低SOX9经抑制ASK1/JNK通路调控小胶质细胞极化，减轻Aβ1-42诱导的神经炎症。

mech.title: Anti-inflammatory CAR-microglia targeting Aβ for Alzheimer's disease therapy.
mech.zh: 靶向Aβ的抗炎CAR小胶质细胞可协同清除斑块并抑制神经炎症，优于单抗疗法。

dx.title: Peripheral Administration of isoD7-Aβ Exacerbates Motor Deficits and Tau Pathology in P301S Mice.
dx.zh: 外周注射isoD7-Aβ加剧P301S小鼠运动障碍并恶化tau病理。

dx.title: Validation of Plasma p-tau217 as a Biomarker of Prodromal Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217经本地验证可有效识别前驱期阿尔茨海默病，支持临床早期诊断应用。

dx.title: Emerging biomarkers for Parkinson's disease in biological fluids.
dx.zh: 脑脊液α-突触核蛋白种子扩增检测可高灵敏诊断帕金森病，血清检测更具临床实用性。

dx.title: Stimulus-Based ApoE Alzheimer's Disease Induction Model Using Microglia-Containing Brain Organoids for Drug Discovery.
dx.zh: 该研究构建含小胶质细胞的脑类器官模型，可模拟ApoE相关AD病理，用于药物筛选。

dx.title: The ILLUMINATE natural history study in colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor-related adult-onset leukoencephalopathy with axonal spheroids and pigmented glia.
dx.zh: 该研究首次前瞻性刻画CSF1R-ALSP临床轨迹，并识别关键生物标志物及潜在试验终点。

dx.title: Amyloid-β-Related Cortical Susceptibility Alterations in Individuals Under Assessment for Alzheimer's Disease: A χ-Separation Study.
dx.zh: χ-separation成像揭示阿尔茨海默病评估中皮层铁沉积与Aβ负荷呈独立空间关联。

dx.title: Streamlining eligibility assessment for Alzheimer's disease-modifying therapies: Prediction of MMSE scores using the digital clock and recall.
dx.zh: 数字时钟与回忆测试结合机器学习可高效预测MMSE评分，简化AD疗法资格筛查。

dx.title: Using reference intervals to improve interpretation of youth sport-related concussion biomarkers using a research platform.
dx.zh: 青少年运动脑震荡血浆NfL和GFAP生物标志物需用参考区间校正解读，否则易误判。

prev.title: Diagnosed oral cavity and salivary gland disorders and the risk of incident Parkinson disease, Alzheimer disease, dementia and all-cause mortality: a retrospective cohort study.
prev.zh: 口腔及唾液腺疾病显著增加帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病、痴呆及全因死亡风险。

prev.title: Abnormal eye movements reflect early cortical and volumetric brain changes in apparently healthy, PM2.5-exposed urban youth.
prev.zh: PM2.5暴露的健康城市青年出现眼球运动异常，提示早期皮层及脑容量改变。

prev.title: Opposing effects of uric acid and triglycerides on cognitive decline cancel within a metabolic oxidative composite: Longitudinal evidence from CHARLS and cross-sectional replication in NHANES.
prev.zh: 尿酸与甘油三酯对认知衰退的相反效应在代谢氧化复合评分中相互抵消。

prev.title: The gut-brain-mitochondria axis in type 2 diabetes-associated cognitive decline: mechanistic convergence, biomarkers, and therapeutic opportunities.
prev.zh: T2DM认知衰退由肠-脑-线粒体轴多机制协同驱动，该轴为生物标志物与治疗干预提供整合靶点。

prev.title: Orthogonal Contributions of Genetic, Clinical, and Social Determinants of Health Risk Burdens on Alzheimer's Disease Pathophysiology.
prev.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health
prev.zh: 遗传、临床与社会健康风险负担独立且正交地影响阿尔茨海默病病理进程。

prev.title: Implementation of a standardized Video-based Asynchronous Neurological Examination (VANE) in a multi-center observational study of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and AD related dementias.
prev.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health
prev.zh: 多中心研究中标准化视频异步神经检查（VANE）可有效识别AD及ADRD相关神经病变。

prev.title: Elevated BrainAGE precedes cognitive impairment and improves prediction of future cognitive decline.
prev.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health
prev.zh: 脑龄差升高先于认知障碍出现，可提升未来认知衰退预测价值。

prev.title: Topography of Juxtaventricular white matter hyperintensities and cognitive associations in Alzheimer's disease: a dual-cohort study.
prev.zh: 近脑室白质高信号与阿尔茨海默病认知损害显著相关，且独立于淀粉样蛋白病理。

intro.title: Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases: pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic strategies.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑发炎会加重老年痴呆和帕金森病，看懂它，能帮你明白为啥现在治不好，以及未来药该往哪儿使劲。

intro.title: Network Biology of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Neurodegenerative Disorders: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Strategies.
intro.zh: 这篇研究把老年痴呆等脑病看成一张互相牵连的“坏网”，告诉我们治病不能只堵一个点，得从整体下手。

intro.title: Worry and Anxiety in the Era of Early Diagnosis and Disease Modifying Treatment for Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是：早查出老年痴呆后，人容易焦虑，而焦虑又会加重病情，所以心理医生得提前介入帮患者稳住心态。

intro.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
intro.zh: 这药能清脑子里的“垃圾蛋白”，但效果因人而异，还可能带来脑肿胀风险，得看值不值。

intro.title: Glycopolymers as emerging modulators of Amyloid-β aggregation: structure-activity relationships and therapeutic potential.
intro.zh: 这篇文章讲的是用糖类聚合物拦住大脑里的“坏蛋白”堆积，帮我们看懂这类新药怎么治老年痴呆，对普通人了解未来疗法有帮助。

intro.title: Oral Microbial Extracellular Vesicles as Novel Mediators of Alzheimer's Pathogenesis: A Critical Review of the Periodontal-Brain Axis.
intro.zh: 简单说，这篇研究讲的是牙周炎细菌释放的微小颗粒可能进入大脑，诱发炎症，增加得老年痴呆的风险，提醒大家护牙就是护脑。

intro.title: Peripheral and Central miRNA Signatures in Alzheimer's Disease: Tissue-Specific Variability, Sex-Associated Differences, and Implications for Blood-Based Biomarkers.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是通过血液里的小分子RNA来早期发现阿尔茨海默病，但男女和身体部位不同会有差异，提醒大家别指望单一指标就能确诊。

intro.title: Analysis of the Efficacy of Acetylcholinesterase Inhibitors in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease, Literature Review.
intro.zh: 这文章就是讲治老年痴呆的常用药到底管不管用，帮家属明白吃药能拖住啥、别指望啥。
